page.description: An implemented tab id, "current" (default), or "all" for every implemented page.

summary.description: The RSS description, used as the fallback body without a second round trip.

ReturnTimeframe.description: Timeframes shared by Dip Finder and Momentum Tracker.
Timeframes shared by Dip Finder and Momentum Tracker.

PortfolioMutation.description: Every write the Portfolio page can make. One channel takes the union and answers with the whole re-read document, so the renderer never guesses at post-write state.

currentPrice.description: Live values, refreshed from Yahoo rather than stored.

hasMarketMark.description: Stored contracts have no live mark until an option quote succeeds.

asOf.description: Provider observation time of the last trade, distinct from retrieval time.

PersonalFinanceMutation.description: Every write the Personal Finance page can make, answered with the whole section.

FinanceCurrency.description:
The Personal Finance page's own book, ported from the PySide6 `net_worth` payload.

Cash and debt rows are natively SGD; portfolios and brokerage accounts are natively USD. `totalsCurrency` picks the display currency for the aggregate views only — the cash and debt tables always print SGD, exactly as the reference does.

BackgroundRequest.description:
Every request the startup warm-up in `src/api/prefetch.ts` can issue carries this.

A request marked `background` runs in the rate gate's background lane (`electron/services/yahoo/rateGate.ts`), so a page the user opens while the warm-up is still fanning out is served first instead of queueing behind a hundred of its requests. It describes *scheduling*, never the answer, so it must stay out of every main-process cache key — a warmed payload and a user-requested one are the same entry.

HeatmapEtfKey.description:
The Heatmap page (`mixins/spy_heatmap.py`, page17) — one index ETF's full holdings list, quote-enriched, grouped into sector tiles.

The presenters, the interval-return arithmetic and the tile colour ramp live in `shared/heatmap.ts` beside each other, so the page, the main process and the probe cannot disagree about what a tile is worth. The intervals are `HeatmapInterval` — `_P17_INTERVALS` and the Portfolio Heatmap's `_P4_HEATMAP_INTERVALS` are the same seven windows, and the reference shares them too.

EtfArbitrageRequest.description: Arbitrage takes only the ticker: the holdings it compares against are the cached ones the main process already loaded, so a five-hundred-row basket does not cross IPC twice just to be quoted.

symbols.description: Used by Portfolio and Custom. ETF sources resolve their official holdings in main.

customPeers.description: Saved per-ticker in the renderer; a change to it re-ranks the peer table.

force.description: Ignore the cached payload and re-download every provider.

year.description: Defaults to the current year, which is the only one the reference ever asks for.

pages.description: The reference export reads pages 1 through 5; the page offers deeper pulls.

expiry.description: Empty, or an expiry no longer listed, falls back to the nearest live one.

AppSettingsMutation.description: Every write the Settings page can make, answered with the whole re-read document.

sortColumn.description: -1 follows the reference's newest-first default; 0-6 address the table columns.
